name: artur-plugins
description: Engineering skills for architecture, governed audits, source-backed documentation, repository instructions, prompts, writing, operations, handover, and Claude/Codex plugin authoring and installation management.

interface.longDescription: One shared skills library for architecture, audits, codebase documentation, repository guidance, prompts, prose, human runbooks, server operations, handover, and plugin authoring and installation management. Audit lifecycle work uses the bundled Python CLI only when requested; the optional MCP server is not registered automatically. No hooks, services, or server processes are started by plugin installation.
defaultPrompt: Review this repository without changing files.
Design an implementation-ready architecture for this task.
Create, inspect, update, or install a plugin for Claude Code and Codex.
